methods.name: Recurrent BRC Schur port-collapse and contextual-signature calculus
capabilities: exact stable-hidden-state Schur elimination to a positive-rational port matrix
construction of reduced finite positive-rational external port contexts
methods.core_law: For W=[[A,X],[Y,B]] with stable A, W_eff=B+Y(I-A)^-1X is the complete exact visible dynamic signature under all finite positive-rational contexts attached only through retained ports. Absolute full loop-zeta additionally requires Z_int=1/det(I-A).
methods.hard_boundary: Positive total-mass finite-rational port semantics only. Equal W_eff does not preserve CWM count/dominant/provenance. Direct future hidden-state access or coupling mutation is outside the lease. No generic Schur/Kron/black-box novelty or runtime-speedup claim.
